title: GPT 5.6 Pro Just Solved a 35-Year-Old Math Problem On Its Own
description:
GPT 5.6 Pro just cracked a math problem thats had everyone stuck for 35 years 🔥 Running solo for 168 minutes it found new bounds on a path optimization problem, the kind physics and ML are built on. It beat everything published since '91 and nearly mached 8 years of Microsoft closed research 😅 AI breaking new ground now, not just copying whats already known ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
